retention.stated: 15 GB per account; 2048 MB per file (split larger files); max 30 subfolders per folder; free accounts deleted if not logged into for 180 days.

egress.terms: Free accounts get ad-supported downloads and no direct/hotlink embedding; direct downloads are a Premium feature ('Direct downloads (file embedding)' starts at the 100 GB / $14.99 per year tier).

tooling: WebDAV endpoint live at webdav.4shared.com; REST API at api.4shared.com / upload.4shared.com (v1_2, JSON+XML); rclone's generic webdav backend has a 4shared-specific fix upstream (commit 65eee67 'webdav: fix Open Range requests to fix 4shared mount').
chaining: 15 GB x unlimited free accounts. Legacy accounts carry stored files; new-account free space is 15 GB.

limits.value: deleted if not logged into for 180 days

reliability_note: Free tier deletes the account and all files after 180 days of inactivity — that alone disqualifies it for a growing archive. Downloads are ad-gated unless you pay.
